sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: The pavilion arose from the need to create a temporary structure capable of providing shade and shelter over a four-day period. Conceived as a meeting place, it is organized around a single shared table, where different groups of people gather throughout the day, fostering informal encounters and collective occupation. Beyond its functional requirements, the project explores architecture as a temporary act of spatial organization.
